scope.sourceRequirement: Distinct public employer board returning published jobs at verification time. Software openings are measured separately and are not guaranteed on every board.
scope.jobRequirement: Only fully remote software roles with explicit eligibility in the US, UK or Ireland, including verified worldwide roles. No paid API or AI calls.

attributions.author: Elliott Dehn / Open Jobs
attributions.changes: Employer identifiers only from the frozen directory, independently verified against live employer endpoints. Snapshot jobs, inferred locations, embeddings and upstream code are not imported.
